name: Inquisitor Remediator
body:
Remediators take matters into their own hands to get a job done with the firm belief that no one is better qualified to right the world’s wrongs than themselves. This is not to say that remediators don’t or can’t work well with others, but they are of the opinion that their way is the right way.

A remediator has the following class features.

Personal Piety

A remediator believes in an amalgam of ideologies that dictate how she lives her life. A remediator’s strict, unwavering adherence to these ideals is the source of her power; it is not granted by a specific deity, and therefore, a remediator’s alignment does not need to be within one step of her deity (if she worships one).

This alters alignment restriction.

Sole Adjudicator (Su)

At 3rd level, when a remediator is the only melee combatant fighting an enemy, she gains a +1 morale bonus on attack rolls and a +1 dodge bonus to AC. These bonuses increase by +1 at 6th and 15th level. At 9th level, a remediator selects a second domain which aids her in accomplishing the tasks necessary to live by her personal code of piety, gaining the granted powers at the prescribed levels just as she does for her domain selected at first level. (This domain is not tied to a particular deity’s host of granted domains.)

This replaces solo tactics and all teamwork feats.
